strategic_horizon.terminal_goal: Ship a personal weak-network VPN with a portable Windows 11 client and self-contained Linux amd64/arm64 server bundles. Sustained payload remains WBD-owned raw TCP-shaped FakeTCP -> pinned wolfSSL DTLS 1.3 -> immutable LINK, with Reality-like setup/admission only, safe platform routing/firewall ownership, and deterministic cleanup.
strategic_horizon.current_milestone: A real Ubuntu deployment of the sequence-54 Linux bundle exposed a deterministic launch defect that automated release checks had missed: the default WBD_LISTEN_IP=0.0.0.0 was passed directly to wbd-faketcp-mux even though raw FakeTCP requires a concrete IPv4. The same report also showed an occupied internal LINK UDP port 127.0.0.1:47000, a 123-iteration systemd restart storm, and a fragile ExecStop=/bin/kill $MAINPID failure. The manager now resolves the host primary IPv4 for raw FakeTCP while keeping Reality on the wildcard listener, removes the explicit ExecStop, uses control-group teardown, limits restart bursts, and exposes the resolved bind in doctor/start logs. A regression test reproduces the wildcard case. Linux release artifacts were rebuilt for amd64/arm64, and their checksum files were additionally fixed to use portable basenames.
strategic_horizon.local_optimization_stop_rule: Do not reopen ADR-0010 release transport semantics for this platform fix. 40 Mbit/s aggregate-inner on <=100 Mbit/s weak links, legacy FakeTCP release default, pinned wolfSSL DTLS, Reality setup-only semantics, ticket/LiveID isolation, immutable LINK, one raw lane, and release FEC off or fixed systematic 20:20 remain frozen unless a future ADR changes them.

deterministic_errors: WBD_LINK_SERVER_MUX_FAIL listen udp4 127.0.0.1:47000: bind: address already in use
wbd-faketcp-mux: --listen must use a concrete IPv4 address
ExecStop kill emitted usage and control process status=1
real_host_failure_evidence.root_cause: The release manager defaulted WBD_LISTEN_IP to 0.0.0.0 for the Reality listener and reused the same wildcard for raw FakeTCP, while cmd/wbd-faketcp-mux/main_linux.go requires a concrete IPv4. The 47000 ownership conflict is a separate host-state condition and must be resolved by identifying the owning process rather than blindly killing listeners.
